Package io.netty.handler.codec.compression

Enum Decompressor.Status

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<Decompressor.Status>
      • io.netty.handler.codec.compression.Decompressor.Status
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<Decompressor.Status>
    Enclosing interface:
    Decompressor
    @UnstableApi
public static enum Decompressor.Status
extends java.lang.Enum<Decompressor.Status>
    Current status of the decompressor. The status indicates which method may be called to make progress on decompression.

    • Enum Constant Summary

      Enum Constants 
      Enum Constant Description
      COMPLETE
      All data has been processed, and the format indicates that no more input may arrive.
      NEED_INPUT
      More input is required before decompression can proceed.
      NEED_OUTPUT
      Output must be consumed before more input can be received.

    • Enum Constant Detail

      • NEED_INPUT

        public static final Decompressor.Status NEED_INPUT
        More input is required before decompression can proceed. Only calls to Decompressor.addInput(io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf) and Decompressor.endOfInput() are permitted.

      • NEED_OUTPUT

        public static final Decompressor.Status NEED_OUTPUT
        Output must be consumed before more input can be received. Only calls to Decompressor.takeOutput() are permitted.

      • COMPLETE

        public static final Decompressor.Status COMPLETE
        All data has been processed, and the format indicates that no more input may arrive. No further decompression operations are permitted, except Decompressor.close() to release resources.
